name: OAuthRefreshToken
description: Plan-32 C — long-lived refresh token issued at /token alongside the access token. Stored as SHA256 hash (tokenHash) — never the raw value — so a DB compromise doesn't leak live credentials. On refresh: rotate (issue a new RT + revoke the prior, set rotatedFromId) per OAuth 2.0 best practice §10.4. revokedAt enables explicit revocation and chain-cutoff on reuse-detection. Lifetime: 30 days. Lives in schema0 only (platformOnly).

attributes.name: tokenHash
attributes.description: SHA256(refresh_token) hex. The raw token is returned to the client at /token and never persisted server-side.

attributes.name: clientId
attributes.description: OAuth client the token was issued to. /token validates the presenter matches.

attributes.name: userTenantId
attributes.description: Tenant baked into the access tokens minted from this RT.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: User baked into the access tokens minted from this RT.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scopes carried forward from the original authorization. Cannot be widened on refresh.

attributes.name: issuedAt
attributes.description: Epoch ms when this RT was created.

attributes.name: expiresAt
attributes.description: Epoch ms. /token sets this to now + 30 days. Refresh resets to issuedAt + 30d (sliding window).

attributes.name: revokedAt
attributes.description: Epoch ms of revocation. Null while live. Set by (a) rotation on refresh, (b) explicit revoke, (c) reuse-detection cascade (a revoked RT being presented at /token revokes the whole chain — see rotatedFromId).

attributes.name: rotatedFromId
attributes.description: Parent RT row id when this token came from a refresh rotation. Lets /token walk the chain and revoke all descendants if a revoked RT is replayed.
